ColonyCouncil.WishDef.label: a pot of tea
ColonyCouncil.WishDef.description: Vanilla Brewing Expanded: someone who is ill would give a great deal for a hot cup of tea.
ColonyCouncil.WishDef.fulfilledWhen: The colony has {TARGET} tea in stock.

wants.reason: {PAWN_nameDef} is unwell and would give a great deal for a hot cup of tea.

plain.li: My throat feels like gravel. A hot cup of tea would do more than any medicine.
When I was sick as a child, someone always brought me tea. I'd like that now.
[cold] I'm cold, I'm coughing, and I'd like something hot to hold.
[night] I can't sleep for coughing. A cup of tea might settle it.
[winter] Winter colds are the worst. Tea with honey, if there's any honey.

warm.li: If someone could brew a pot, I'd share it. Half of us are sniffling.

cheerful.li: Tea makes everything better, even this cold!

gloomy.li: It won't cure me. It'll make being sick less miserable.

cold.li: A warm drink eases the symptoms. The cost is minor.

plain.li: Hot tea and the steam in my face. I feel half human again.

warm.li: Thank you. That was the kindest thing anyone's done for me all week.

cheerful.li: A whole pot just for me. Well, nearly.

plain.li: Cold water it is.

gloomy.li: Nobody brings tea to the sick here.

plain.li: Still coughing. Still no tea.

ColonyCouncil.WishDef.label: {THING} for summer evenings
ColonyCouncil.WishDef.description: Vanilla Cooking Expanded: a cook has been thinking about meat over hot coals all week and wants a grill.
ColonyCouncil.WishDef.fulfilledWhen: The colony has {THING}, or another grill.

wants.reason: {PAWN_nameDef} cooks, and has been thinking about meat over an open grill all week.

plain.li: Meat over hot coals, outside, on a warm evening. That's what I'm asking for.
Grilled food tastes of summer. Let's build {THING}.
[evening] Smell the air tonight? It's grilling weather.
[summer] It's too hot to cook indoors anyway. Let me cook outside on {THING}.
[afterraid] After a day like that, everyone deserves skewers and a fire.

warm.li: Everyone gathered round the grill, waiting their turn. That's the best kind of supper.

cheerful.li: Skewers, sausages, grilled corn! I'll need {THING} for all of it.

gloomy.li: Summer's short. We should enjoy at least one evening of it.

plain.li: Everyone came out when they smelled it. I didn't have to call anyone.

warm.li: The first skewer is yours, since you built it.

blunt.li: Good. Stand back from the coals.

cheerful.li: I've burned three things and they were all delicious.

gloomy.li: Grilled everything. Summer will be over soon.

plain.li: Back to the stove, then.

gloomy.li: Summer went by without a single grilled meal.

plain.li: Still no grill. Still summer.

ColonyCouncil.WishDef.label: a bed kept for guests
ColonyCouncil.WishDef.description: Hospitality: visitors have come and the colony has no bed set aside for guests. A kind or sociable colonist would like one, so nobody who comes in peace sleeps on the floor.
ColonyCouncil.WishDef.lostText: {FOR_nameDef}'s guest bed is no longer kept for guests.
ColonyCouncil.WishDef.fulfilledWhen: A bed in the colony is set aside for guests.

plain.li: The visitors slept in the barn last night. We can do better than that.
People who come in peace should have somewhere to sleep. Let's keep one bed for guests.
[trait:Kind] They'd walked for days to get here, and we gave them the floor.
[night] Visitors are bedding down in the yard. It's cold out there tonight.
[rich] We've plenty of everything. We can spare a bed for guests.
[small] We need friends out here more than most. Being good hosts is how we make them.

warm.li: A warm bed and a hot meal. That's all it takes to make a friend.

blunt.li: Guests on the floor make us look poor. Set a bed aside.

cheerful.li: A guest room, with a flower on the pillow!

gloomy.li: If we treat visitors badly, they'll stop coming. Then it's just us.

cold.li: Well-treated guests bring trade and goodwill. A bed is cheap.

plain.li: The guests had a real bed tonight. They thanked me twice.

warm.li: Thank you. We're the kind of place people want to come back to now.

cheerful.li: I put a flower on the pillow anyway.

gloomy.li: Now we just need visitors who don't try to kill us.

plain.li: The floor will have to do for them.

blunt.li: Fine. Let them sleep in the mud.

gloomy.li: Nobody will want to visit us now.

plain.li: Still no bed for guests.

ColonyCouncil.WishDef.label: {THING} for the fields
ColonyCouncil.WishDef.description: Vanilla Furniture Expanded - Farming: a grower tired of watching wild animals eat the crops wants a scarecrow.
ColonyCouncil.WishDef.fulfilledWhen: The colony has {THING}, or another scarecrow.

wants.reason: {PAWN_nameDef} has watched wild animals eat the crops for the last time.

plain.li: Something has been eating the rice right down to the roots. I'd like a scarecrow out there.
Hares in the corn again. A scarecrow would keep the small ones away.
[morning] I went out at dawn and there were deer in the field, bold as anything. We need {THING}.
[fall] The harvest is nearly in. I'd hate to lose the last of it to the birds and the hares.
[poor] We can't afford to share our crops with every animal on the map.

warm.li: I'll make it myself, if you like. Old clothes, some hay, a friendly face.

blunt.li: The animals are eating our food. Build {THING}.

cheerful.li: A scarecrow! I'll give it a hat and a name.

gloomy.li: We grow it, they eat it. That's been the story all season.

cold.li: Crop losses to small animals are measurable. A scarecrow ends most of them.

plain.li: Not a hare in the field this morning. It's working.

warm.li: Thank you. I gave it my old hat.

blunt.li: Good. Now the crops are ours.

cheerful.li: I named it after the council. It looks just like you.

gloomy.li: The birds will figure it out eventually. For now, it works.

plain.li: The animals will keep eating, then.

blunt.li: Don't blame me when the harvest is thin.

gloomy.li: Half the field for us, half for them.

plain.li: Something ate the seedlings again last night.
